title: Avishkar OS Structured Log Record
description: The shape every Logger implementation (any language) must emit when json_output is enabled, so logs from a Python core module and a future TypeScript one are correlatable in the same log pipeline.

module.description: The logger name -- conventionally the framework/module's directory name, e.g. 'core.config' or 'agent-factory'.

correlation_id.description: Ties log records across module boundaries to one logical request/task. Null if none is bound in the current context.

fields.description: Arbitrary structured context bound via Logger.bind() or passed at the call site. Never put secrets here -- see STANDARDS.md SS6.

exception.description: Present only for error-level records raised from an exception.
